about.title: About Baltimore County Public Schools
about.content: Baltimore County Public Schools, also known as BCPS, serves students across Baltimore County, Maryland, from Towson and Catonsville to Dundalk, Pikesville, Parkville, Essex, Owings Mills, and county communities outside Baltimore City. This page summarizes the districtwide Pre-Labor Day Start calendar published by BCPS.

about.title: How to Use This BCPS Calendar
about.content: Use this page for districtwide BCPS calendar dates, including opening day, the first full kindergarten day, holidays, professional development days, conference days, early-closing assessment days, spring break, winter break, emergency closure makeup days, and the scheduled last student day. Individual schools may publish separate dates for testing, athletics, performances, graduation details, and campus events.

planningTips.title: What Baltimore County Families Should Check
content: BCPS uses a Pre-Labor Day Start calendar, so students begin before Labor Day and the first full kindergarten day may be later than the first day for other grades.
Elementary and prekindergarten conference days do not affect every grade level the same way; families with students in different schools should check the grade-level note on each conference date.
The calendar includes three emergency closure makeup days near the end of the school year. The scheduled last day can move if BCPS uses those makeup days.
Several dates close schools three hours early for students, including marking period and assessment-related dates.

customSections.label: How the BCPS Calendar Is Structured
customSections.content: The official BCPS calendar uses separate labels for student attendance, teacher duty, professional development, classroom preparation, conference days, assessment days, early closings, and emergency closure makeup days. That structure matters because some dates close schools for all students, some apply only to prekindergarten or elementary students, and some are staff duty days that families may still experience as student no-school days.

customSections.label: Dates Baltimore County Families Usually Miss
customSections.content: The dates most likely to affect family schedules are not only the major breaks. Watch the first full kindergarten day, conference dates that apply only to specific grade levels, three-hour early-closing days, professional development days when schools are closed for students, and the emergency closure makeup days listed near the end of the year.

customSections.label: Emergency Closure Makeup Days
customSections.content: BCPS states that the calendar includes three emergency closure makeup days. If no emergency closure days occur, the school year ends on the scheduled last student day. If closures occur, BCPS uses the listed makeup days in order. If more than three emergency closures occur, BCPS says it will use virtual learning, with no more than eight virtual days. The district may also revise holidays, professional development days, spring break, early releases, or the end of the school year if additional instructional time is required.

customSections.label: What This BCPS Calendar Covers
customSections.content: This page covers the districtwide Baltimore County Public Schools Pre-Labor Day Start calendar. It does not replace school-specific calendars for campus events, athletics, graduation details, testing windows, or program-level notices. Families should confirm school-specific schedule changes directly with BCPS or their assigned school.

districtFaqs.q: Which Baltimore County Public Schools calendar does this page summarize?
districtFaqs.a: This page summarizes the official BCPS Pre-Labor Day Start calendar for the selected school year.

districtFaqs.q: What does Pre-Labor Day Start mean for BCPS?
districtFaqs.a: Pre-Labor Day Start means the BCPS school year begins before Labor Day. Families should not assume a post-Labor Day opening; check the first day listed for the specific school year.

districtFaqs.q: Does the BCPS calendar apply to every school event?
districtFaqs.a: No. The district calendar covers systemwide dates such as student opening day, holidays, conference days, professional development days, breaks, early closings, and makeup days. Schools may publish separate dates for testing, athletics, performances, graduation activities, and campus events.

districtFaqs.q: How does BCPS handle emergency closure makeup days?
districtFaqs.a: BCPS lists three emergency closure makeup days near the end of the school year. If schools close for emergencies, those days may become student attendance days in the order listed by the district.

districtFaqs.q: What should families know about BCPS conference days?
districtFaqs.a: Some BCPS conference days apply only to prekindergarten, kindergarten, or elementary students. Middle and high schools may remain in session on dates when younger grades do not attend.

districtFaqs.q: Does the BCPS calendar include early-closing days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The BCPS calendar lists several three-hour early-closing dates for students, including dates connected to marking period endings, professional development, Thanksgiving, and assessment days.

districtFaqs.q: Can I add the BCPS calendar to Google Calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Download the .ics file from this page and import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. The file is a one-time import and does not automatically sync with later BCPS revisions.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify BCPS calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Baltimore County Public Schools calendar page and district announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent calendar reference and is not affiliated with BCPS.
